research_interests: My broader area of research is to work on the existence of primitive pair, the existence of r-primitive k-normal pair and the existence of a finite arithmetic progression of r-primitive elements with first term being k-normal, with prescribed traces and norms over finite fields. Further, numerical calculations are carried in SageMath to provide some illustrations.
skills: Languages & Frameworks: Proficient in Matlab, LATEX, SageMath.
projects: Title of the Thesis: Existence of Primitive Normal Elements with some Properties in Finite Fields

Institute: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi, New Delhi, India Hardy Hilbert Spaces & Toeplitz Operators : I have made a Project titled as above, enlightening Elementary introduction to Hardy-Hilbert Space and Spectral Properties of Toeplitz Operators under guidance of Dr. Jitendriya Swain Sir, Assistant Professor, Department of Mathematics, IIT Guwahati.

Abelian Forcing Set: I have given a Seminar on Abelian Forcing Set. i.e if (ab)n = anbn for all a,b belonging to a group G then which property of these n’s would imply that G is abelian at IIT Guwahati.
